content.text:
Image 1: Eight-panel storyboard reference, used for the overall shot structure, shot sizes, and camera-movement rhythm. Read it from left to right and from top to bottom; panel N is Shot N.
Image 2: Live-action reference of The Quinn family mansion, living room, used as the benchmark for environmental composition, lighting, and realistic live-action texture; it contains no people.
Image 3: Subject 1 (Cassie) character appearance reference.
Image 4: Subject 2 (Natalie) character appearance reference.
Image 5: Subject 3 (Lauren) character appearance reference.
[Subject settings]
Subject 1 (Cassie): Refer to Image 3. 23, Lauren's daughter and Natalie's spoiled stepsister, who schemes to send Natalie into the marriage meant for her. Outfit: A pale-pink silk slip dress with thin straps, falling to mid-thigh, under a cropped white tweed-texture long-sleeve jacket worn open. Pink strappy heeled sandals. All plain, with no logos. Signature colour: pink.
Subject 2 (Natalie): Refer to Image 4. 25, George's daughter from his first marriage, struggling to pay for her sick mother's dialysis; the drama's heroine. Outfit: A worn light-blue knit cardigan, open, over a plain white crew-neck short-sleeve cotton T-shirt. Faded mid-blue straight-leg jeans and plain white canvas sneakers. She carries a simple brown canvas shoulder bag. Everything is plain, with no logos or prints. Signature colour: blue.
Subject 3 (Lauren): Refer to Image 5. 50, George's second wife and Natalie's stepmother, Cassie's mother; the controlling matriarch of the Quinn mansion. Outfit: A fitted crimson-red long-sleeve knee-length sheath dress with a round neckline, a thin gold belt at the waist, nude pointed-toe high heels and a pearl necklace. All plain, with no logos. Signature colour: red.
Environment (The Quinn family mansion, living room): Refer to Image 2. Day, soft natural daylight from the tall windows. Soft natural daylight comes through the sheer curtains of the windows on the left wall at frame left. The chandelier is unlit and faint warm wall sconces glow. Live sound is heels clicking on marble, paper rustling and the quiet room tone of the mansion.
Do not swap the characters' appearances, clothing, actions, positions or dialogue.
[Overall style]
Photorealistic live-action short drama with cinematic lighting. Each character keeps the face and the outfit with its main colour from their reference image throughout. Use each character sheet only for that character: the face from the close-up on the right, the body and outfit from the turnaround on the left; do not render the sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. This segment has 5 lines, in this order: Cassie, Cassie, Natalie, Cassie, Lauren. Generate speech only from the lines in {} in the shot list, each spoken exactly once by its speaker; everyone else keeps their mouth naturally closed while listening, and a V.O. speaker keeps their mouth closed or is off screen. Follow the shot list below; do not add cuts or camera moves beyond it. Strictly adhere to the 180-degree rule: within a scene, characters keep their screen sides and the camera stays on one side of the axis. Seamless continuity of action, spatial matching and consistent actor blocking; cut on action. For dialogue prefer static shot-reverse-shot and over-the-shoulder shots, balanced with reaction shots and close-up inserts. Faces stable and clear, consistent with the reference images, with no resemblance to any real actor or actress. Normal human eyes. Natural anatomy and hands. Natural, fluid motion that follows the blocking; characters make subtle, natural movements. Characters, props and environment share one world with matched lighting. Each line ends naturally with breathing room and is never cut off. Authentic performances with micro-expressions. No BGM; generate only dialogue, environmental sounds and action sounds. No subtitles.
[Strictly exclude]
George in frame or an empty sofa or empty sofa seat in frame. hands clasped, gripping or overlapping each other or an object in frame. anyone entering or leaving through the arched fireplace alcove. readable text on the hospital statement. subtitles or captions. Dialogue from the wrong character, multiple people speaking at once, repeated or missing lines, lip-sync errors and audio-visual desynchronization. The raw reference images (character sheets, setting plates) appearing as a frame of the video, and starting on a still frame of the setting reference. A fast zoom-in at the start, a fast pull-back at the end, unmotivated whip-pans, tilts, zooms and 360-degree orbits. Axis-crossing, jump cuts, frame skips, flicker and clipping. Characters or props popping in or vanishing, and duplicate characters except mirror reflections. Readable text, numbers, logos and watermarks; phones and paper are shown from the back or out of focus. Black-and-white, monochrome, grayscale, desaturated visuals; hand-drawn, sketch, line art, illustration, comics, animation; storyboard frames, rough sketches, panel borders, gutters and grid layouts.
[Shot list] (8 shots, approximately 17 seconds)
When a previous-shot reference image is given, Shot 1 matches its camera position, shot size and blocking and continues from that moment; do not repeat that frame later.
At the start: The camera stays on the near side of the coffee table, facing the back wall. The windows are at frame left, and the open rectangular doorway in the right wall at frame right is empty. Natalie sits in the front-left armchair, angled toward the sofa, eyes downcast and glassy without tears. Her bag hangs from her shoulder and her hands rest apart on her knees. The front-right armchair is empty. George sits slumped on the sofa's left end with his hands on his knees; every shot is framed to exclude the sofa's left end, so he stays out of frame. Lauren sits upright on the sofa's right end, facing camera, hands resting still in her lap. The one flat hospital statement lies on the coffee table at the end nearest Natalie. The arched fireplace alcove behind the sofa is not a doorway.
Shot 1 (0-2s): [Wide shot, eye-level, locked-off from the near side just behind Natalie's front-left armchair, turned to face the right wall squarely. Behind Cassie are the pale grey right wall and its open doorway, which fill the frame; the back wall with the sofa lies entirely beyond frame left, so no part of the sofa is in frame.] Cassie walks in through the open doorway in the right wall. The empty front-right armchair stands in the mid-ground, and Natalie's shoulder and bag strap fill the foreground at frame left. Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sing-song, mocking): {Aww.} <Heels click on marble>
Shot 2 (2-6s): [Medium shot, low angle from the near side beside the front-left armchair, facing the right wall, tilting up from Natalie's shoulder to Cassie's face. Behind Cassie are the upper pale grey right wall, the top of the open doorway and the unlit chandelier. The back wall with the sofa lies beyond frame left and below frame.] Cassie stops at the right side of Natalie's armchair, on the coffee-table side, her arms hanging relaxed at her sides. She looks down at Natalie with a smirk. Dialogue (Cassie, in English, saccharine, drawn-out sarcasm): {If it isn’t my loser sister asking for money like a beggar? How pathetic?}
Shot 3 (6-8s): [Close-up, high angle from Cassie's side on the near side, looking down at Natalie's face, locked-off. Behind her are only the cream armchair cushion and the ivory rug; the sofa lies above frame.] Natalie lowers her eyes and her lips tremble. Her eyes are glassy, with no tears.
Shot 4 (8-10s): [Medium shot, eye-level, from the near side facing the left-wall windows, tilting up with Natalie as she stands. Behind her are the sheer-curtained windows. The sofa lies beyond frame right and her hands stay below the lower frame edge.] Natalie bends toward the coffee table, takes up the hospital statement below frame and rises from the front-left armchair. Her bag hangs from her shoulder. <Paper rustles>
Shot 5 (10-12s): [Medium shot, eye-level, tracking backward on the near side ahead of Natalie as she walks toward the right-wall doorway. The camera faces the left-wall windows squarely, framed tight on her face and shoulders, so behind her are only the sheer-curtained windows and Cassie by the armchair; the back wall and the sofa lie beyond frame right.] Natalie walks away from the front-left armchair along the near edge of the coffee table toward the doorway. Her face is set and pale, and her hands hang at her sides below frame. Cassie stands out of focus behind her by the armchair. Dialogue (Natalie, in English, low, wounded): {This is a mistake.}
Shot 6 (12-14s): [Medium close-up, eye-level, quick push in from the near side by the front-right armchair on Cassie beside the front-left armchair. The camera faces the left wall, so behind her the sheer-curtained windows fill the background and the sofa lies beyond frame right.] Cassie turns her head toward frame right after Natalie and lifts her chin, a scheming glint in her eyes, her hands still at her sides. Dialogue (Cassie, in English, bright, sly): {Wait, we'll give you the money.}
Shot 7 (14-16s): [Medium shot, eye-level, locked-off from the near side facing the right wall on Natalie at the doorway. Behind her are only the pale grey right wall and the open doorway frame; Cassie and the sofa lie beyond frame left.] Natalie stops in mid-step just inside the right-wall doorway and turns her head back over her shoulder toward the room. The hospital statement hangs at her side below frame.
Shot 8 (16-17s): [Medium close-up, eye-level, whip pan from the near side leftward from the doorway, landing tight on Lauren's face and shoulders at the sofa's right end, facing the back wall. Behind her are the sofa back and the potted fig at the right of the arch. The sofa's left end lies beyond frame left and the right-wall doorway beyond frame right.] Lauren snaps her head toward Cassie at the front-left armchair and sits forward in surprise, eyes wide, her hands still in her lap. Dialogue (Lauren, in English, startled): {What?}
At the end: The camera stays on the near side of the coffee table, facing the back wall, windows at frame left. Natalie stands just inside the right-wall doorway at frame right, beside the empty front-right armchair, turned back toward the room. She holds the flat hospital statement at her side, her bag hangs from her shoulder, and her eyes are glassy without tears. Cassie stands at the right side of the empty front-left armchair, on the coffee-table side, facing Natalie toward frame right, arms relaxed at her sides. Lauren sits forward on the sofa's right end, turned toward Cassie, hands still in her lap. George sits on the sofa's left end, out of frame.
